pages.text: A few quality of life things that can be nice to get during the Lunar Plane simulation.

A $(item)Garden Cloche$() can grow crops when given some $(item)Power$() and a steady supply of $(item)Water$().$(br2)Search for $(item)Cloche$() in $(item)JEI$() to see available $(item)Fertilizers$() and their potency.
Waystones let you travel around the world in a speedy manner.$(br2)You can travel to them using a $(item)Warp Stone$() or by activating another $(item)Waystone$().
A $(item)Warp Stone$() will allow you to travel to previously placed $(item)Waystones$() around the world.$(br2)There is a 30 second cooldown period after using the stone.
This nifty gadget will supply you with a source of $(item)Infinite Water$().$(br2)Will be very helpful later on.

pages.title: Night Ritual
pages.notes: Don't have the patience to wait for pesky stuff like the passage of time? Use this ritual to instantly make it $(item)Nighttime$().$(br2)Takes a small amount of $(item)LP$() to activate, the $(item)Lapis Block$() should be on top of the $(item)Imperfect Ritual Stone$().

pages.text: You can't always be everywhere at once. This little guy can $(item)Automate$() tasks that you would normally do with your own $(item)Hands$().$(br2)Unlocks quite late in this $(item)Simulation$().
A mean of transferring items between inventories. Use Servos/Retrievers to move items through ducts.
A mean of transferring liquids between inventories. Use Servos/Retrievers to move liquids through ducts.
A $(item)Chunk Loader$() will allow you to have parts of the simulation loaded even though you're not nearby.$(br2)One per base should do, use spot loaders for small setups in other simulations.
Can be split into $(item)Spot Loaders$(), which will load the chunk they are in.

As soon as you get your first $(l:sim_2/1_primitive_energy)energy$(), you could use it to power a $(item)Storage Scanner$(). It can craft and connect nearby inventories.$(br2)Very useful for crafting since you wont have to check every chest for materials manually.
